method: The initial audit used Parallel.ai (max_age_seconds=86400, stale-cache fallback disabled), with independent official web-reader and calculator checks. Later reviews use official pricing pages and product documentation. Each record identifies its retrieval method and date. Summaries describe published components and limitations. The November 19 review records source-backed findings for every directory entry and labels figures by product. A fee, minimum or announced promotion is not a payout price.

providers.name: 1Money
providers.summary: USD same-day ACH costs $0.55 each way. USD international SWIFT costs $10 to deposit and $25 to withdraw. These are USD bank-rail fees.

routeNotes.label: INR payouts coming soon
routeNotes.reason: 1Money lists INR pay-in and payout as coming soon. Its published USD ACH and SWIFT fees do not price an INR payout.

pricingReview.label: Rail fees published
pricingReview.reason: Public USD ACH and SWIFT fees cover bank rails. INR payouts are listed as coming soon.

providers.name: Airwallex
providers.summary: The US fee schedule lists a 0.50% standard EUR FX margin, $1 for a local EUR transfer and $2 for a local INR transfer. Grow and Accelerate are exempt from the local transfer fee. SWIFT costs $15 (SHA) or $25 (OUR).

routeNotes.label: Business payout · fees vary
routeNotes.reason: Airwallex supports local INR payouts. The public USD-to-INR calculator illustrates a U.S. business sending money. Airwallex lists Singapore as the onboarding entity for India-registered businesses, so confirm the plan and price for your own account.

fees.summary: USD 2 standard local INR payout fee and 1.00% standard FX margin for currencies in the other-currency tier. Grow and Accelerate plans waive the local fee. Confirm actual markup, taxes and plan with Airwallex.

routeNotes.label: US business payout
routeNotes.reason: The public calculator shows a U.S. business sender’s exchange rate before fees. The current fee schedule lists standard fees separately; the sender’s plan and rail determine the final price.

routeNotes.label: U.S. business payout · published fees
routeNotes.reason: Airwallex publishes an indicative US business exchange rate. Final conversion and fee depend on the sender’s plan and local transfer method.

fees.summary: 0.50% standard SGD FX margin and USD 1 standard local SGD payout fee. Grow and Accelerate plans waive the local fee. Confirm applicable tax and account rate.

pricingReview.label: Account and rail matter
pricingReview.reason: The US fee schedule and currency calculators cover different parts of a transfer. The account plan, FX and payout rail determine the final price.

providers.name: Al Ansari Exchange
providers.summary: The UAE bank-transfer schedule groups India with four other destinations and lists AED 0–25.24 plus 5% VAT. The exact fee depends on the destination, currency and amount.

routeNotes.label: UAE calculator starts in AED
routeNotes.reason: The documented India remittance calculator starts with AED from the UAE. Its fee range does not provide a price for USD-funded transfers.

pricingReview.label: AED-funded calculator
pricingReview.reason: Public India estimates are funded in AED from the UAE. The fee depends on amount and payout method.
pricingReview.feeHighlight: AED 0–25.24 + VAT for the listed group

routeNotes.label: Crypto ramp pricing
routeNotes.reason: Alchemy Pay documents quotes for buying or selling crypto. Its INR payment methods for buying crypto do not establish a USD-to-INR bank transfer price.

pricingReview.label: Crypto ramp quote
pricingReview.reason: The quote API prices the purchase or sale of a digital asset. A fiat-to-fiat bank payout needs a different product.

routeNotes.label: INR payout not listed
routeNotes.reason: Alfred publishes USD and Latin American rails, including MXN, BRL, COP and ARS. Its coverage page does not list local INR payouts.

pricingReview.label: LATAM payout coverage
pricingReview.reason: Published bank and local-rail coverage centers on Latin America. Ask Alfred for a route and commercial quote.

pricingReview.label: Institutional custody pricing
pricingReview.reason: Fee disclosures depend on the Anchorage entity and product. The covered stablecoin schedule is separate from custody and bank payout pricing.

pricingReview.label: Wallet pricing unverified
pricingReview.reason: Anclap’s site describes a wallet and digital assets. A current bank-transfer tariff for this comparison could not be verified from its public pages.

providers.name: ARQ (formerly DolarApp)
providers.summary: ARQ Mexico lists a 3 USDc charge when using its US account details. Other payment products have separate tariffs.

pricingReview.label: Mexico account tariff
pricingReview.reason: The Mexico account publishes fees for several funding routes. Confirm the exchange rate, account market and destination method in ARQ.

providers.name: Aspora
providers.summary: Official US help says the transfer fee is dynamic and shown in the app after entering the amount. The public first-transfer zero-fee offer is conditional; no standard FX rate is assumed.

pricingReview.label: US-to-India remittance
pricingReview.reason: Aspora’s US help centre describes its personal remittance flow and bank funding. The price depends on the sender, amount and funding method.

pricingReview.label: Institutional RFQ
pricingReview.reason: B2C2 describes negotiated OTC crypto execution and an all-in price on request. The spread depends on the trade.

pricingReview.label: Card-program fees
pricingReview.reason: Baanx publishes fee documents mapped to specific card programs and jurisdictions. Ask the program for the applicable tariff.

providers.name: Banking Circle
providers.summary: Banking Circle adds EUR 20 per OUR transaction to its standard fees. Account pricing and FX are separate.

pricingReview.label: SWIFT surcharge published
pricingReview.reason: The operational schedule identifies the OUR surcharge separately from standard fees and FX.

providers.name: Banxa
providers.summary: Card/Apple Pay purchases have a published 1.99% processing fee. Network charges and variable Banxa/partner/recovery spreads are additional; zero processing fee on another method does not mean zero total cost.

routeNotes.label: Crypto buy or sell
routeNotes.reason: Banxa’s EUR SEPA payout prices the sale of a crypto asset. Its hosted checkout does not quote a USD-funded fiat bank transfer to EUR.

pricingReview.label: Crypto order fees
pricingReview.reason: Its buy and sell checkout has asset, processing and network charges. A digital-asset trade is a different product from a USD-funded bank payout.

pricingReview.label: Account-specific custody fees
pricingReview.reason: BitGo publishes billing methodology for custody and transaction activity. The contracted fee rate depends on the custody or wallet agreement.

providers.name: Bitso
providers.summary: Exchange maker/taker fees vary with 30-day volume. These are crypto exchange fees, not a fiat MXN-to-USD bank-transfer quote. Bitso Business pricing requires its own terms.

pricingReview.label: Local rails and trade fees
pricingReview.reason: Bitso publishes country-specific deposits and withdrawals plus separate trading charges. The total depends on currency and both legs.

providers.name: Bitso / Juno
providers.summary: Bitso Business offers commercial payment infrastructure. Retail Bitso crypto trading tariffs and similarly named Juno services are not substituted for this product’s commercial quote.

pricingReview.label: MXNB mint and redeem
pricingReview.reason: Juno’s business terms relate to the MXNB product. The transfer amount, token, banking rail and account agreement determine applicability.

providers.name: BlindPay
providers.summary: Published platform subscriptions depend on plan and billing interval. Subscription prices are separate from the FX rate, rail fees and amount-specific payout quote.

routeNotes.label: Account quote required
routeNotes.reason: BlindPay supports USD virtual accounts and a separate EUR SEPA payout flow funded with stablecoins. The payout quote requires an authenticated instance and a registered recipient bank account.

pricingReview.label: Authenticated rail quote
pricingReview.reason: BlindPay’s public page prices subscription plans. A payout quote still needs an instance and a registered recipient.

providers.name: Botim Money
providers.summary: Botim’s UAE-to-India page advertises no fee on the first eligible transfer. Later fees vary by amount, funding method and payout method.

pricingReview.label: AED app quote
pricingReview.reason: The UAE calculator shows an indicative exchange rate. The app confirms fee and rate for the funding and delivery methods. International transfers require a UAE mobile number and Emirates ID for verification.
pricingReview.feeHighlight: First eligible AED→INR transfer: AED 0 fee

providers.name: Brale
providers.summary: US bank rails: USD 0.25 ACH, USD 2 RTP and USD 20 wire; USDT conversion 0.05%. Network and program terms are separate. These USD components do not establish an international FX payout price.

pricingReview.label: US rail fees published
pricingReview.reason: Brale’s US stablecoin accounts have channel-specific fees. These do not establish a converted international payout.

pricingReview.label: Product and partner pricing
pricingReview.reason: The disclosure describes Bridge and partner fees separately. Rate and fee depend on the platform, fiat rail, asset, and transaction.

providers.name: BriskPe
providers.summary: The public business page lists USD 16 through USD 2,000; USD 25 through USD 10,000; then 0.25%, with GST applicable. Marketplace and card products have different tariffs; a final FX quote is still needed.

pricingReview.label: Plan and collection terms
pricingReview.reason: The provider markets collected export receipts and card acceptance separately. Confirm the applicable collection plan and tax before quoting.

providers.name: BVNK
providers.summary: Internal BVNK-wallet transfers are free under the EU pricing policy. External transfers, FX and platform fees can be charged according to the contract.

pricingReview.label: Contracted fee and FX
pricingReview.reason: The EU pricing policy specifies pre-agreed charges and discloses network estimates at transaction time.

providers.name: Careem Pay
providers.summary: The official transfer help directs customers to the app for exact fees. Destination, Careem Plus membership and transfer history change pricing; cashback is not a standard fee reduction.

pricingReview.label: UAE remittance fee rules
pricingReview.reason: Country, amount, eligibility and payout method determine the rate and fee shown in the UAE app.

providers.name: Cashfree Payments
providers.summary: The public pricing page includes payment-gateway tariffs. Those card-processing fees do not price Global Collections bank receipts. Use the specific account’s collection and FX quote.

pricingReview.label: Collection product quote
pricingReview.reason: Cashfree has published gateway processing fees. Its Global Collections bank-transfer product has a separate price.

routeNotes.label: Global Collections · quote required
routeNotes.reason: For eligible Indian businesses receiving client payments via US ACH. Cashfree requests an account quote for its current collection fee.

sources.label: US ACH collection and FX terms

fees.summary: Cashfree advertises no FX markup for eligible collections and an e-FIRA at no extra charge. Its current collection fee is available on request.

Cashfree published 1%–1.5% depending on volume for local collections in major currencies including USD. That was USD 10–15 on USD 1,000 before any separately applicable charges. Confirm the current rate and GST.

pricingReview.label: Banking partner terms
pricingReview.reason: CBW Bank provides bank and embedded-payment services. The sources checked did not establish a standard cross-border rate card for partners.

pricingReview.label: Merchant risk pricing
pricingReview.reason: Checkout.com quotes payment processing based on the business profile and risk category. Interchange++ is a pricing structure rather than an amount.

pricingReview.label: Mint tariff is separate
pricingReview.reason: Circle publishes product fee schedules by legal entity. A Circle Payments Network corridor still needs the participating institution’s rate and fee.

providers.name: ClickPesa
providers.summary: ClickPesa’s Tanzania merchant card collection schedule lists a 4.85% fee charged to the customer. It prices bank and mobile disbursements separately.

pricingReview.label: Tanzania payout tariff
pricingReview.reason: The Tanzania schedule lists transaction-band fees for mobile money and bank disbursements. A conversion from a different currency needs a separate FX quote.

providers.name: Coinbase
providers.summary: Coinbase Exchange publishes volume-tiered maker fees of 0%–0.40% and taker fees of 0.04%–0.60% for its standard order book.

pricingReview.label: Exchange trading fees
pricingReview.reason: The trading spread or exchange fee is distinct from cash-out and cross-border bank delivery.

providers.name: Coins.ph
providers.summary: Coins Pro Tier 0 lists 0.10% maker and 0.15% taker. Larger trailing trading volumes can reduce the fees.

pricingReview.label: Philippine trading tariff
pricingReview.reason: Coins.ph publishes Coins Pro trading tiers. Use its cash-out terms separately for a PHP settlement.

pricingReview.label: Contract and FX disclosure
pricingReview.reason: Conduit’s terms say the applicable FX fee is disclosed before conversion. The bank rail and partner agreement determine final charges.

pricingReview.label: Treasury quote
pricingReview.reason: Cowrie offers institutional liquidity and settlement for Nigeria and Ghana. The price depends on currency, size and settlement arrangement.

pricingReview.label: Bank partner pricing
pricingReview.reason: Cross River supplies payments infrastructure to program partners. The public bank materials do not establish an end-customer corridor tariff.

providers.name: Crossmint
providers.summary: EU disclosure publishes card processing ranges of 0.5–4.5%, possible non-USD/EUR currency conversion fees of 0.5–2%, and orchestration ranges of 0.03–0.40%. Partner, network and contract charges can apply. Ranges cannot produce a guaranteed route total.

pricingReview.label: Crypto fee ranges published
pricingReview.reason: The EU disclosure covers crypto processing and orchestration. Multiple charges can apply to a transaction.

pricingReview.label: Account-specific FX and payment fees
pricingReview.reason: Currencycloud’s terms describe client fee arrangements and pre-trade rates. An amount-specific quote is account dependent.

providers.name: DashX
providers.summary: The calculator advertises a flat 0.30% platform fee with no FX markup. The public figure does not specify GST treatment.

pricingReview.label: India collection fee published
pricingReview.reason: DashX advertises its flat fee on the converter. GST inclusion and the executable account rate require confirmation.

pricingReview.label: Product and country pricing
pricingReview.reason: dLocal Go collects merchant payments at country/payment-method rates. Enterprise payouts use separate commercial terms.

providers.name: dtcpay
providers.summary: The official virtual-account schedule is dated 23 May 2024 and lists SGD 100 monthly maintenance at balances up to SGD 100,000. This historical account-service tariff is not a current transaction FX or payout quote.

pricingReview.label: Virtual-account tariff
pricingReview.reason: The schedule prices specific virtual-account rails. Conversion and onward payout need the applicable account terms.

providers.name: e& money
providers.summary: The public AED-to-INR calculator displayed AED 15.75 including VAT for its bank-account example. The final app quote depends on amount, corridor and delivery method.

pricingReview.label: AED app and calculator
pricingReview.reason: The UAE service has an AED exchange calculator. The app determines the transfer fee for the amount and destination method.

pricingReview.label: On-chain route quote
pricingReview.reason: Eco Routes quotes swaps and sends on supported blockchains. The route and liquidity price depend on the assets; bank delivery is separate.

pricingReview.label: Issuer platform pricing
pricingReview.reason: Episode Six supplies ledger and card-program infrastructure. A programme contract is needed for processing costs; it does not quote retail transfers.

pricingReview.label: Stablecoin mint and redeem
pricingReview.reason: Ethena’s USDe terms describe subscription and redemption in eligible assets by eligible mint users. The exchange price and bank payout would be separate.

pricingReview.label: Platform plan pricing
pricingReview.reason: Fireblocks lists plan features and custom tiers. The quoted payment price also depends on the connected rail, liquidity provider and plan.

providers.name: Flutterwave
providers.summary: The public regional payout schedule lists Ghana bank payouts at GHS 10 and Ghana mobile-money payouts at 1.50%.

pricingReview.label: Local payout tariff
pricingReview.reason: Flutterwave publishes country and rail tables. The advertised local payout charge does not determine the rate for a cross-currency transfer.

pricingReview.label: Merchant plan pricing
pricingReview.reason: FOMO Pay describes its merchant payment and business products. The commercial package and rail determine the price.

pricingReview.label: Token and channel quote
pricingReview.reason: Fonbnk lists mobile-money and airtime rails by country. Rates are specific to the rail, currency, token and partner.

pricingReview.label: Liquidity quote required
pricingReview.reason: Fuze says pricing is sourced from liquidity providers. The quote depends on asset, size and account terms.

pricingReview.label: Country-specific calculator
pricingReview.reason: Global66 offers country-specific transfer flows and local terms. Use a quote for the actual sending country, amount and payout method.

pricingReview.label: Crypto checkout quote
pricingReview.reason: Guardarian’s quotes are for fiat-to-crypto or crypto-to-fiat orders. Amount, asset and payment method change the price.

pricingReview.label: Card-program terms
pricingReview.reason: Highnote’s money-movement documentation describes network and instrument eligibility; pricing depends on the card or bank programme.

providers.name: Immersve
providers.summary: The Immersve virtual prepaid card schedule lists a 1.5% foreign-currency purchase fee.

pricingReview.label: Prepaid card tariff
pricingReview.reason: Its published card fees apply to the virtual prepaid card. Issuing-as-a-service and external cash movement have different terms.

providers.name: Infinity
providers.summary: Infinity publishes a 0.50% standard bank-payment fee with zero FX markup, and states the fee includes GST.

pricingReview.label: India collection tariff
pricingReview.reason: The standard tariff is for bank payments to eligible Indian exporters. Card payments and large transfers are quoted separately.

providers.name: Karbon
providers.summary: Official inward-remittance FAQ lists FX conversion, transfer fees, taxes and possible intermediary bank charges. The breakdown depends on sender country, currency and payment method.

pricingReview.label: Account and rail quote
pricingReview.reason: Karbon’s fees depend on currency, origin, route and the bank that handles the payment. Use the account or calculator for the exact amount.

pricingReview.label: API quote required
pricingReview.reason: Koywe documents a time-limited negotiated quote per size, rail and currency pair rather than a public universal fee.

pricingReview.label: Embedded crypto terms
pricingReview.reason: Lirium’s digital-asset purchase, sale and custody terms define a transaction-specific exchange rate. Programme and trade fees need a quote.

providers.name: LuLu Exchange
providers.summary: LuLu’s UAE rate board lists AED 19.50 and AED 26.50 including VAT in the two India INR account-transfer brackets. The live FX conversion and precise eligibility are separate.

pricingReview.label: UAE fee schedule
pricingReview.reason: LuLu publishes a UAE remittance fee board by destination and payout method. The app or agent confirms currency conversion and eligibility.
pricingReview.feeHighlight: AED 19.50 / 26.50 incl. VAT to INR bank

pricingReview.label: Partner quotation
pricingReview.reason: Mastercard Move is a network for participating banks and platforms. The originating institution sets the customer’s fee and exchange rate.

providers.name: Mercuryo
providers.summary: Mercuryo lists a crypto buy fee up to 5.5% with a EUR 1 minimum, or a sell fee up to 3.95% with a EUR 4 minimum.

pricingReview.label: Crypto retail fee range
pricingReview.reason: The fee schedule covers crypto buys and sells. Network or partner conditions change the final checkout.
pricingReview.feeHighlight: Crypto sale: up to 3.95%, EUR 4 minimum

pricingReview.label: Embedded crypto checkout
pricingReview.reason: Mesh’s product connects crypto accounts and wallets. The relevant merchant programme or wallet route determines fees.

providers.name: Mobee
providers.summary: Official trading help lists IDR spot totals of 0.120% buy and 0.280% sell; non-IDR totals of 0.350%. Pair-specific rules, VIP tiers, withdrawals and execution price must also be checked. These crypto trading components do not price a fiat bank remittance.

pricingReview.label: Indonesia exchange costs
pricingReview.reason: Trading and local cash-out fees depend on the Indonesian exchange order and withdrawal method.

pricingReview.label: Issuing programme pricing
pricingReview.reason: Monavate offers embedded card issuance and payment infrastructure. The partner agreement is needed for a complete programme tariff.

providers.name: MoneyGram
providers.summary: Retail transfer fees depend on origin, funding, payout method and FX. MoneyGram publishes U.S. remittance tax rules and regional agent fee schedules. Live partner quotes include the fee, taxes, exchange rate and recipient total.

pricingReview.label: Retail calculator
pricingReview.reason: MoneyGram’s calculator prices retail transfers by country, funding and payout method. A live API quote requires MoneyGram partner access.

routeNotes.label: Retail transfer fees · India
routeNotes.reason: Personal remittance evidence for U.S. senders. Confirm exchange rate, recipient payout and location-specific fees with MoneyGram.

fees.summary: USD 0 transfer fee for an eligible first U.S. online transfer to India. Credit cards are excluded. FX still applies.

fees.product: Nevada agent fee schedule · India cash pickup
fees.summary: Published fees in USD: $11 on $0.01–$500, $13 on $500.01–$1,000, and $20 on $1,000.01–$2,500. India cash payout is capped at the equivalent of $2,500. The schedule says market-area fees may vary. FX and any applicable tax are separate.
1% of the send amount on qualifying U.S. transfers funded with cash, a money order, cashier’s check or similar physical instrument. Collected from the sender, separately from the transfer fee.

routeNotes.label: Retail transfer fees · Pakistan
routeNotes.reason: Published Nevada agent fees for personal transfers. Confirm exchange rate, recipient payout and location-specific fees with MoneyGram.

fees.product: Nevada agent fee schedule · Pakistan cash pickup
fees.summary: Published fees in USD: $11 on $0.01–$500, $13 on $500.01–$1,000, $20 on $1,000.01–$2,500, and $30 from $2,500.01. The schedule says market-area fees may vary. FX and any applicable tax are separate.
1% of the send amount on qualifying U.S. transfers funded with cash, a money order, cashier’s check or similar physical instrument.

providers.name: MoonPay
providers.summary: MoonPay advertises crypto buy fees as low as 1% for bank transfers and 4.5% for Visa card funding. Minimum, partner and network charges can apply.

pricingReview.label: Crypto on-ramp pricing
pricingReview.reason: Rates depend on payment method, asset, geography and any network or partner charges.

pricingReview.label: Card and account programme
pricingReview.reason: Moorwand’s terms refer to product-specific card and account charges. The programme or account terms are needed for the fee.

providers.name: Mulya
providers.summary: Mulya describes a 1% all-inclusive transfer fee for its standard international collection product.

pricingReview.label: India collection tariff
pricingReview.reason: Mulya publishes its standard exporter collection fee. Currency support and actual FX are confirmed at withdrawal.

pricingReview.label: Account payout quote
pricingReview.reason: The payout API returns fees and the exchange rate for the specific route; integration fees can be added by the partner.

providers.name: n.exchange
providers.summary: n.exchange publishes a 2%–3% service fee for crypto pairs.

pricingReview.label: Crypto swap fee range
pricingReview.reason: The FAQ prices crypto swaps. Fiat on/off-ramp and foreign bank delivery are separate.

pricingReview.label: Custom fee and FX rules
pricingReview.reason: Nium documents route-specific fixed and variable fees with configurable FX margins. A contracted account is needed for the exact quote.

pricingReview.label: Enterprise payment terms
pricingReview.reason: Onafriq’s enterprise payments documentation describes platform payouts. The network partner supplies corridor-specific cost and FX.

providers.name: Due
providers.summary: Due lists zero separate channel fee for on-chain payouts. Fiat rails and conversions can still be charged under the quote.

pricingReview.label: Channel and FX quote
pricingReview.reason: Due documents fees on the incoming and outgoing rails, FX markup and optional partner fees.

providers.name: OpenPayd
providers.summary: The official pricing FAQ states that pricing is completely bespoke. A commercial quote is required; old starting-from tariffs cannot establish a current account-specific total.

pricingReview.label: Commercial pricing
pricingReview.reason: OpenPayd explains its arrangement-specific rates for accounts and transfers. A customer agreement is needed for exact fees.

pricingReview.label: Institutional account pricing
pricingReview.reason: Parfin provides institutional custody and asset infrastructure. The cost depends on its enterprise product and account arrangement.

pricingReview.label: Stablecoin redemption terms
pricingReview.reason: Paxos publishes issuance and redemption terms for particular stablecoins. Minting or redeeming a stablecoin does not price an onward FX payout.

pricingReview.label: Card programme pricing
pricingReview.reason: PayCaddy’s product is embedded card issuance and program accounts. These need a partner rate card rather than a consumer remittance price.

providers.name: PayGlocal
providers.summary: Bank collections advertise USD 10 through USD 2,000, USD 18 through USD 7,500, then 0.25%, plus 18% GST.

pricingReview.label: India bank collection tariff
pricingReview.reason: Multi-currency bank collections and card checkout have separate pricing. The published bank collection tiers include an additional GST line.

providers.name: Payoneer
providers.summary: The public fee table distinguishes receiving accounts, payment requests, card/ACH funding and withdrawals. A receiving fee alone does not include the account-specific USD-to-INR conversion and withdrawal cost.

pricingReview.label: Account withdrawal range
pricingReview.reason: The amount depends on receiving method, withdrawal currency, account location and monthly volume.

providers.name: PayPal
providers.summary: India merchant payments list 4.40% plus a currency-specific fixed fee. Currency conversion has a separate markup. This merchant tariff is different from Xoom personal remittance.

pricingReview.label: India merchant processing
pricingReview.reason: The merchant receiving tariff covers commercial checkout. Currency conversion, cross-border charges or applicable taxes can be additional.
pricingReview.feeHighlight: 4.40% + fixed fee for listed international receipts

providers.name: PayZoll
providers.summary: PayZoll publishes USD 10 below USD 1,000 and 1% from USD 1,000. Banking, partner, conversion and corridor-specific charges may apply. The observed dashboard calculator confirms the USD-to-INR payout fee formula.

pricingReview.label: USD payout calculator
pricingReview.reason: The USD-to-INR dashboard calculator confirms the published fee formula. The payout rate and partner charges can vary.

pricingReview.label: Canadian deposit-account tariff
pricingReview.reason: Published fees cover the Canadian personal account. The embedded-payments business requires partner terms.

providers.name: PingPong
providers.summary: PingPong’s India help page lists free account creation and receiving. Its general withdrawal or supplier-payment fee is 1% per transaction, with regional variation.

pricingReview.label: Regional withdrawal tariff
pricingReview.reason: PingPong’s India help page gives a standard withdrawal/supplier charge and says regional rates can differ.
pricingReview.feeHighlight: 1% stated withdrawal fee, varies by region

pricingReview.label: Card processing contract
pricingReview.reason: Pomelo’s LATAM card issuing and processing service is set up with a programme and applicable local rates.

providers.name: Ramp Network
providers.summary: Ramp Network lists published percentage caps varying by rail, from up to 1.40% to up to 5.45% on the cited on-ramp table. Each method has its own minimum and conditions.

pricingReview.label: Crypto ramp tariff
pricingReview.reason: The pricing policy lists processing caps and minimums by funding method. Network and integration fees can affect the final quote.

pricingReview.label: Method and merchant terms
pricingReview.reason: Rapyd’s pricing model varies by payment method and country. Card acquiring and payout agreements have separate fee schedules.

routeNotes.label: Rapyd Disburse · account quote

fees.summary: The published Rapyd Disburse self-onboarding agreement lists 3% plus USD 20, equivalent to USD 50 on USD 1,000 if that schedule applies. Confirm contracted fees, conversion and GST on the merchant account.

providers.name: Razorpay

pricingReview.label: India bank collection tariff
pricingReview.reason: MoneySaver’s bank account export product has a different fee from card checkout and payment links.

providers.name: Refrens
providers.summary: Refrens publishes 1.5% or less for bank/ACH/wire with a USD 60 processing cap and included tax. Conversion is separate.

pricingReview.label: Fee published, FX separate
pricingReview.reason: The bank/ACH/wire tariff covers processing. The executable FX rate is needed for a complete collection price.

routeNotes.label: Published product settles in INR
routeNotes.reason: Refrens accepts SGD as a collection currency for its Indian export product and settles eligible collections in INR. There is no documented SGD bank payout for this product.

fees.summary: Published bank/wire fee of 1.5% or less, capped at USD 60, including taxes for Indian INR settlement. FX is additional.

providers.name: Remitly
providers.summary: USD-to-INR welcome rates apply to new customers only, once per customer, on the first USD 6,000. Ongoing pricing depends on amount, funding and delivery method. Fresh comparison observations retain their original time.

pricingReview.label: Retail calculator and offer
pricingReview.reason: Remitly shows different rates for new-customer promotions, payment speeds and delivery rails. The regular price depends on account and choices.

routeNotes.label: USD 0 transfer fee at USD 1,000+
routeNotes.reason: Remitly’s U.S. fee schedule lists USD 3.99 below USD 1,000 and USD 0 from USD 1,000. An eligible first transfer can have a different fee and rate.

routeNotes.label: US bank-funded personal transfer
routeNotes.reason: The Singapore calculator publishes a first-transfer rate on the first USD 1,500 for eligible senders. Choose bank deposit at checkout for the precise payout.

pricingReview.label: Enterprise partner pricing
pricingReview.reason: Ripple Payments offers institution and corridor-specific services. Published coverage does not provide a universal customer tariff.

providers.name: Salt
providers.summary: Salt advertises a 1.75% fee with GST included and no exchange-rate markup. Current account availability and the applied rate require confirmation.

pricingReview.label: India collection fee advertised
pricingReview.reason: The inward payment page publishes a fee including GST. Confirm account availability and the active rate before using it.

routeNotes.label: Published product settles in INR
routeNotes.reason: Salt accepts SGD as a collection currency for its Indian export product and settles eligible collections in INR. There is no documented SGD bank payout for this product.

fees.summary: Published 1.75% including GST, for eligible Indian INR settlement.

pricingReview.label: Institutional OTC quote
pricingReview.reason: SCRYPT prices trades on request using the pair, amount and execution details. It does not publish a universal retail transfer tariff.

providers.name: Skydo
providers.summary: Skydo publishes USD 19 up to USD 2,000, USD 29 up to USD 10,000 and 0.3% above that, plus 18% GST.

pricingReview.label: India bank collection tariff
pricingReview.reason: The India collection account lists flat USD slabs or a percentage fee above the threshold. Sender-bank charges can apply.

pricingReview.label: Institutional liquidity quote
pricingReview.reason: Sphere’s institutional desk prices liquidity and settlement for the specific asset, size and destinations.

pricingReview.label: Bank platform terms
pricingReview.reason: Stablecore sells infrastructure to banks and credit unions. Public rail coverage does not expose an end-customer fee schedule.

providers.name: StraitsX
providers.summary: Singapore personal StraitsX accounts list a USD 40 outbound USD bank transfer fee. Separate bank charges can apply.

pricingReview.label: Singapore personal account tariff
pricingReview.reason: The personal-account fee schedule prices individual rails and stablecoin operations. Exchange and bank charges can be separate.

routeNotes.label: Verified account · live FX quote required
routeNotes.reason: StraitsX documents USD funding and SGD withdrawals to a bank account in your own name. Third-party funds are a different product. The account confirms the applicable conversion rate.

fees.summary: USD bank funding and SGD bank withdrawal are free from StraitsX. FX spread and possible bank charges are separate. USD withdrawal has a USD 40 charge, which does not apply to SGD withdrawal.

providers.name: Stripe
providers.summary: Stripe India lists 3% for eligible Mastercard/Visa cards issued outside India and an extra 2% when currency conversion is required. Other card categories differ.

pricingReview.label: India merchant card tariff
pricingReview.reason: Stripe’s India pricing covers merchant card acceptance. Card region, currency conversion and the merchant contract determine the final cost.

providers.name: Taptap Send
providers.summary: UAE help says Taptap Send does not charge for card or bank funding, while issuers/banks can charge. The offered FX rate is still needed for the total transfer cost.

pricingReview.label: Sender-country quote
pricingReview.reason: Taptap Send publishes sender-country terms. The app determines the exact fee and rate for the selected payout method.

providers.name: Tazapay
providers.summary: For non-high-risk industries, official support lists APM transaction fees of 0.80–2.50% and card fees of 3.8% + USD 0.50. Local/wire settlement fees and Indian FIRC charges can be separate. The offered FX rate, product and tier boundaries still need confirmation.

pricingReview.label: Checkout tariffs published
pricingReview.reason: Tazapay’s fee tables list payment-method fees across markets. Account payout and currency conversion require their own terms.

providers.name: Tether
providers.summary: Tether.to lists a USD 100,000 minimum, a 0.1% acquisition fee and a redemption fee equal to the larger of USD 1,000 or 0.1%.

pricingReview.label: Direct mint/redemption tariff
pricingReview.reason: Tether’s direct issuance and redemption schedule is for eligible verified Tether.to users. Bank fees and a local-currency conversion are separate.

pricingReview.label: Card programme contract
pricingReview.reason: Thredd documents how to configure card programme fees. The platform price and any partner fees are contractual.

pricingReview.label: Contracted network pricing
pricingReview.reason: The network terms put the transaction fee in the partner’s order document and tie it to the payment method. FX and fees can be quoted per transfer.

pricingReview.label: Crypto checkout quote
pricingReview.reason: Partner, payment-method and network fees depend on the crypto purchase or sale. Its checkout returns the price for that order.

pricingReview.label: Merchant and payout pricing
pricingReview.reason: The provider lists separate merchant crypto payments, crypto payouts and fiat payouts. Use the specific plan and quote for fees.

pricingReview.label: Merchant agreement pricing
pricingReview.reason: Unlimit’s processing and payment-account fees depend on geography, payment method and merchant agreement.

providers.name: Vibrant
providers.summary: Vesseo lists 0.5% for sending Stellar USDC to another Stellar wallet, with a 1 USDC minimum withdrawal.

pricingReview.label: Vesseo wallet tariff
pricingReview.reason: The Vibrant/Vesseo fee schedule names specific assets and deposit/withdrawal methods. Bank cash-out rates depend on the partner route.

pricingReview.label: Originating partner quote
pricingReview.reason: Visa Direct supplies payout rails to financial institutions and approved partners. The sending partner confirms the end-customer price.

pricingReview.label: Bank programme terms
pricingReview.reason: WebBank supplies bank partnership programmes. The applicable product or partner agreement determines fees.

providers.name: Winvesta
providers.summary: Railor's published standard USD collection reference is USD 3 + 0.99% for up to USD 2,000 in monthly receipts. Non-JPMC account fees include the additional 18% GST in the estimate.

pricingReview.label: Collection tariff varies by account
pricingReview.reason: Winvesta’s tier depends on total monthly receipts, currency, and account type. GST treatment differs by account.
pricingReview.feeHighlight: USD 3 + 0.99% on the standard USD tier

providers.name: Wio Bank
providers.summary: The September 2026 Wio Business schedule lists AED 52.50 and AED 26.25 as the plan-specific foreign-currency outbound SWIFT charges, before any correspondent charges.

pricingReview.label: UAE business SWIFT tariff
pricingReview.reason: Wio publishes different fees by plan; correspondent charges and FX can be separate.

providers.name: Wise
providers.summary: Wise Business India applies 18% GST to Wise conversion and e-FIRC fees. Its published and help-centre pages should be checked for the charges on the selected business receipt.

pricingReview.label: Different send and receive prices
pricingReview.reason: A public sender quote and an India Wise Business collection price cover different products. Final fees depend on funding and payout.
pricingReview.feeHighlight: 18% GST on Wise India receiving fees

providers.name: Xflow
providers.summary: Starter: USD 12 through USD 2,000, then 0.6%; Growth: USD 20 through USD 5,000, then 0.4%; large invoices use custom pricing. The FAQ distinguishes fixed fees and FX markup for GST/RCM treatment. Plan and tax eligibility affect the final total.

pricingReview.label: India receiving plans
pricingReview.reason: Xflow publishes tiers for export collections. It confirms the selected plan and wallet-to-bank FX in the account.

providers.name: Xoom
providers.summary: The US public calculator returns ACH, card and other funding quotes for bank deposits. An eligible first transfer can include a promotional FX rate; the app confirms final terms.

pricingReview.label: Transfer calculator and promotion
pricingReview.reason: Xoom shows rates and fees before sending. Promotional rates, funding, amount and destination affect the total.

routeNotes.label: US bank funding · USD 0 at USD 1,000+
routeNotes.reason: Xoom waives the transfer fee for eligible U.S. bank-funded transfers of at least USD 1,000 to Indian bank accounts or UPI. The sender’s FX rate still applies.

fees.summary: USD 0 transfer fee at USD 1,000 or above for an eligible transfer. An introductory FX rate can differ from the rate for returning customers.

routeNotes.label: US bank-funded personal transfer
routeNotes.reason: Xoom prices SGD bank deposits from the US in its public calculator. Choose bank funding to see its fee.

pricingReview.label: API quote required
pricingReview.reason: Yellow Card’s business API handles quotes and payment instructions by corridor. Its rail, liquidity and account terms determine the cost.

pricingReview.label: Platform and issuer charges
pricingReview.reason: Zero Hash documents stablecoin issuer fees and partner-facing programme pricing. The specific asset, funding rail and agreement determine the end-user fee.
